narrative_lines.title: Onto2AI Entitlement
narrative_lines.text: This demo shows how Onto2AI turns an entitlement ontology into a validated package for row-level filtering and column-level masking.

narrative_lines.title: The Entitlement Challenge
narrative_lines.text: Entitlement rules often live in scattered implementation details. That makes them hard to review, hard to validate, and risky for AI-assisted data access.

narrative_lines.title: The Goal
narrative_lines.text: The goal is a governed entitlement model that can be inspected as ontology and consumed as implementation-ready artifacts.

narrative_lines.title: Core Domain Model
narrative_lines.text: The core entitlement model is intentionally direct. Users inherit policy through groups, and policies collect the rules that govern access.

narrative_lines.title: Protected Data Context
narrative_lines.text: The ontology also models the protected data surface: database, schema, table, column, connection profile, and sensitivity classification.

narrative_lines.title: Row Filter Rules
narrative_lines.text: For row-level access, row filter rules describe the target column, the comparison semantics, where values come from, and how a query can be rewritten.

narrative_lines.title: Column Mask Rules
narrative_lines.text: For column-level protection, column mask rules describe how protected values are revealed, redacted, tokenized, substituted, or nullified.

narrative_lines.title: Generate Artifacts
narrative_lines.text: From that ontology, Onto2AI packages generated artifacts: schema JSON, query context, Neo4j constraints, and a Pydantic application model view.

narrative_lines.title: Validate Before Publish
narrative_lines.text: Before publishing, the entitlement package runs a smoke test that applies constraints, loads representative sample data, and validates the topology.

narrative_lines.title: Package Independently
narrative_lines.text: The result is an independent domain package. Teams consume the entitlement standard without copying the entire modelling workbench.

narrative_lines.title: Onto2AI Entitlement
narrative_lines.text: That is the Onto2AI entitlement workflow: model policy meaning once, generate aligned artifacts, validate them, and package the result for delivery.

bullets: Create one semantic source for data-access policy structure.
Generate application-ready schema, constraints, and code model artifacts.

slides.title: Core Domain Model
bullets: User belongs to policy groups.
Policy groups include policies.
Policies contain row-filter and column-mask rules.

slides.title: Protected Data Context
bullets: Relational database, schema, table, and column describe the target surface.
JDBC connection profiles capture connection metadata.
Sensitivity classification marks protected columns.

slides.title: Row Filter Rules
bullets: Target the filtered column context.
Capture comparison operator, match mode, and value source type.
Keep LLM rewrite instruction and deterministic rewrite template together.

slides.title: Column Mask Rules
bullets: Target columns that require masking.
Select mask action, masking method, and fallback behavior.
Capture mask value expression and rewrite template.

slides.title: Generate Artifacts
bullets: RDF ontology remains the source of truth.
Generated artifacts include schema JSON, query context, constraints, and Pydantic.
The package can later support other application code model targets.

slides.title: Validate Before Publish
bullets: Smoke test creates a safe generated Neo4j database by default.
It applies constraints and loads representative entitlement sample data.
It validates required properties and all app topology relationships.

slides.title: Package Independently
bullets: The entitlement model is packaged separately from the core toolset.
Consumers get RDF, generated artifacts, and validation workflow.
The package becomes a governed enterprise standard for application teams.
